You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import json
def predict(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    C=comps(gi)
    # palette: vertical or horizontal line comp (n>=2)
    pa=[c for c,cells in C if len(cells)>=2 and (max(p[0] for p in cells)-min(p[0] for p in cells)==len(cells)-1 or max(p[1] for p in cells)-min(p[1] for p in cells)==len(cells)-1)]
    p=pa[0]; cells=p[1]
    if max(p[1] for p in cells)>max(p[0] for p in cells):
        axis='v'; slots=sorted({p[0] for p in cells})
        order=[g[r][c] for r,c in sorted(cells)]
    else:
        axis='h'; slots=sorted({p[1] for p in cells})
        order=[g[r][c] for r,c in sorted(cells)]
    shapes=[(col,cells) for col,cells in C if len(cells)>max(len(c) for c in [p for _,p in C])]
    # simple: largest comps are shapes
    shapes=sorted(C,key=lambda x:-len(x[1]))
    shps=[(col,cells) for col,cells in shapes if len(cells)>3]
    pattern=None; shapecol=None
    for col,cells in shps:
        rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=set(p[1] for p in cells)
        if len(cs)>1 or (len(cells)>3 and max(rs)-min(rs)>0):
            pass
        # find comp with >1 distinct row AND >1 distinct col? shape spans 2D
        drow=max(rs)-min(rs); dcol=max(cs)-min(cs)
        if drow>0 and dcol>0:
            shapecol,colr=col,min(rs); pattern={(p[0]-min(rs),p[1]-min(cs)) for p in cells}; break
    hh=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; ww=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    def stamp(color,top,bottom,left):
        for r in range(top,bottom+1):
            for c in range(left,left+ww):
                if (r-min(rs),c-min(cs)) in pattern:
                    out[r][c]=color
    matched=[o for o in order if any(o==c_ for c_,cc in shps)]
    # slot: pair of color and its row/col run; assign by position in order, find shape occupying that slot
    for idx,s in enumerate(order):
        t=(min(slots[idx]) if False else None)
        if axis=='v': st=sorted(slots)[idx]; scolor=order[idx]
        else: st=sorted(slots)[idx]; scolor=order[idx]
        cand=[(col,cells) for col,cells in shps if min(p[0] for p in cells)<=st<=max(p[0] for p in cells) or min(p[1] for p in cells)<=st<=max(p[1] for p in cells)]
        if axis=='v': cand=[(col,cells) for col,cells in shps if min(p[0] for p in cells)==st]
        else: cand=[(col,cells) for col,cells in shps if min(p[1] for p in cells)==st]
        if cand: stamp(cand[0][1],min(p[0] for p in cand[0][1]),max(p[0] for p in cand[0][1]),min(p[1] for p in cand[0][1]))
        elif scolor not in [c for c,_ in shps]:
            src=next((cells2) for col,cells2 in shps for cells2 in [cells2] if True)[:0]
            # inherit pattern from any shape, recolor to scolor
            refcol=shps[0][1]
            stamp(scolor,min(p[0] for p in refcol),max(p[0] for p in refcol),min(p[1] for p in refcol))
    return out

    hh=max(rs)-r0+1; ww=max(cs)-c0+1

def f(g):
    C=comps(g)
    big=max(C,key=lambda s:len(s[1]))
    # small comps = comps other than big comp(s); exclude big's color cells if a small comp also has that color
    others=[s for s in C if s is not big]
    # palette colors: colors of all small comps (even duplicates) ordered by first occurrence
    pos=[]
    for col,cells in others:
        mr=min(p[0] for p in cells); mc=min(p[1] for p in cells)
        pos.append((mr,mc,col))
    pos.sort()
    Plist=[col for _,_,col in pos]
    n=len(Plist)
    rs=[p[0] for p in big[1]]; cs=[p[1] for p in big[1]]
    r0=min(rs); c0=min(cs)
    pat={(p[0]-r0,p[1]-c0) for p in big[1]}
    hh=max(rs)-r0+1; ww=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    b=None
    for col,cells in others:
        ts=min(p[0] for p in cells)
        i=Plist.index(col)
        v=ts-i*hh
        if b is None: b=v
        elif b!=v: print("conflict",col,ts,i,b,v)
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(len(g))]
    for i,col in enumerate(Plist):
        t=b+i*hh; bot=t+hh-1
        for r in range(t,bot+1):
            for cc in range(c0,c0+ww):
                if (r-r0,cc-c0) in pat: out[r][cc]=col
    return out
